description: This source file handles core operations related to git object files, including packing, unpacking, creation, verification, streaming, and transaction management within the Git object database. It includes functions for handling loose and packed objects, cache management, and fsck checks.

classes.name: struct odb_source_loose
classes.description: Represents a loose object source, holds cache and associated source info.

classes.name: struct odb_loose_read_stream
classes.description: Represents a stream for reading loose objects, including zlib stream state and mapped data.

classes.name: struct odb_transaction
classes.description: Manages a transactional context for batch object database operations.

classes.name: struct transaction_packfile
classes.description: Represents a packfile being created during a transaction, including temporary name, hashfile, and entries.

classes.name: struct object_info
classes.description: Stores metadata about an object, such as type, size, and content pointer.

methods.name: int check_and_freshen_file(const char * fn,int freshen)
methods.description: Checks existence and optionally updates the modification time of a file.

methods.name: int check_and_freshen_source(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid,int freshen)
methods.description: Checks and optionally updates the timestamp of a loose object in a source.

methods.name: int format_object_header(char * str,size_t size,enum object_type type,size_t objsize)
methods.description: Formats an object header string with type and size.

methods.name: int check_object_signature(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,void * buf,unsigned long size,enum object_type type)
methods.description: Verifies the signature (hash) of an object file against its expected oid.

methods.name: stream_object_signature
methods.description: Streams an object's signature (hash) for verification.

methods.name: int stat_loose_object(struct odb_source_loose * loose,const struct object_id * oid,struct stat * st,const char ** path)
methods.description: Retrieves stat info for a loose object given its oid.

methods.name: int open_loose_object(struct odb_source_loose * loose,const struct object_id * oid,const char ** path)
methods.description: Opens a loose object file by oid.

methods.name: int odb_source_loose_has_object(struct odb_source * source,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if a loose object exists in the source.

methods.name: format_object_header
methods.description: Generates the header string for an object with given type and size.
